pictures.name: SR1-Hot-Hills
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Bare rocky hills under a blazing white-gold sky, heat haze, dry scrub. Mardana, a lean Muslim musician of about forty with a short dark beard, a small cap and a plain white robe, carrying a rabab (a wooden lute), walks wearily, wiping his brow, his lips dry, the rabab slung on his back. Ahead of him on the path, Guru Nanak, a figure in a long saffron-brown robe and a simple soft turban, seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible. Deep blue shadows under the rocks, a single far hill with a small hut on top.

pictures.name: SR2-Spring-On-Top
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The top of a rocky hill beside a small clear spring under a lone tree. An old Sufi dervish, Wali Qandhari, painted with dignity, with a grey beard, a dark green robe and a tall felt cap, sits beside the water with his arms folded, turning his face away from the request. Before him, Mardana, a lean Muslim musician of about forty with a short dark beard, a small cap and a plain white robe, carrying a rabab (a wooden lute), holds out an empty clay cup, pleading. Hot gold light, blue sky.

pictures.name: SR3-New-Spring
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The foot of the rocky hill. Mardana, a lean Muslim musician of about forty with a short dark beard, a small cap and a plain white robe, carrying a rabab (a wooden lute), kneels beside a heavy flat stone he has just lifted aside, and drinks with joy from his cupped hands as clear fresh water bubbles up from the ground into a sparkling pool. A little behind him, Guru Nanak, a figure in a long saffron-brown robe and a simple soft turban, seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible, stands watching calmly. Cool blue water, warm gold light.

pictures.name: SR4-Boulder
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A steep rocky hillside in late afternoon. A huge round boulder tumbles down the slope in a cloud of golden dust. Far above, small on the hilltop, the old dervish in a dark green robe and tall felt cap stands with arms raised from the push. Far below, tiny and calm at the foot of the hill, Guru Nanak, a figure in a long saffron-brown robe and a simple soft turban, seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible. Dramatic but not violent, no one hurt.

pictures.name: SR5-Handprint
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The huge round boulder has stopped at the foot of the hill, dust settling in gold light. Pressed into its face is the clear print of an open human hand. Fresh water flows quietly beside it. Mardana, a lean Muslim musician of about forty with a short dark beard, a small cap and a plain white robe, carrying a rabab (a wooden lute), stands at the side, amazed. Calm, still, sacred mood.

pictures.name: SR6-Today-Calm
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style (lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light), a modern scene, main subject in the middle. No text, letters or logos. A city bus stop at evening under a streetlamp. A young Sikh man in a navy turban and a simple jacket stands steady and calm, one open hand raised at chest height in a gentle “easy, easy” gesture, facing an angry man in a work vest who is shouting; behind the young man an older woman with shopping bags is safe and steady. Nobody is touching. Blue dusk, warm gold streetlight, a feeling of calm strength.
